unique_requirements.title_en: Mandatory Pre-Market Conformity Verification Certification by ISP
unique_requirements.title_zh: 由公共卫生研究所（ISP）强制性的上市前符合性验证认证
unique_requirements.requirement_en: Any natural or legal person intending to manufacture, import, commercialize, or distribute the elements mentioned in Article 1 must obtain the respective conformity verification certification previously from services, institutions, laboratories, or establishments that have express sanitary authorization granted by the Instituto de Salud Pública de Chile (ISP).
unique_requirements.requirement_zh: 任何打算制造、进口、商业化或分销第1条所述元素的自然人或法人，必须事先从获得智利公共卫生研究所（ISP）明确卫生授权的服务、机构、实验室或场所获取相应的符合性验证认证。
unique_requirements.audit_question_en: Do you possess the required conformity verification certification issued by the Instituto de Salud Pública de Chile (ISP) prior to placing this device on the Chilean market?
unique_requirements.audit_question_zh: 在将该设备投放智利市场之前，贵公司是否已获得由智利公共卫生研究所（ISP）颁发的所需符合性验证认证？
unique_requirements.rationale_en: ISO 13485 defines the QMS processes to ensure conformity, but it does not mandate that a specific national health authority (ISP) must grant an external 'conformity verification certification' as a prerequisite for market entry in Chile. This is a regulatory gatekeeping requirement.
unique_requirements.rationale_zh: ISO 13485 定义了确保符合性的 QMS 流程，但它没有强制要求特定的国家卫生机构（ISP）必须作为进入智利市场的先决条件颁发外部的“符合性验证认证”。这是一个监管门控要求。
unique_requirements.original_text: Las personas naturales o jurídicas que, a cualquier título, pretendan fabricar, importar, comercializar o distribuir los elementos indicados en el artículo 1º, deberán obtener previamente la respectiva certificación de la verificación de la conformidad en los servicios, instituciones, laboratorios o establecimientos que cuenten con una autorización sanitaria expresa para ello, otorgada por el Instituto de Salud Pública de Chile.
unique_requirements.english_translation: Natural or legal persons who intend to manufacture, import, commercialize or distribute the elements indicated in Article 1 must previously obtain the respective conformity verification certification from services, institutions, laboratories or establishments that have express sanitary authorization for it, granted by the Institute of Public Health of Chile.
unique_requirements.semantic_note: This is a mandatory regulatory hurdle. ISO compliance alone is insufficient; specific national approval from ISP is required before sales/distribution can begin.
